Upcoming workshops

Jul 12

Summer Succulent Bowls

Saturday · 11am–1pm · $48 per person · All supplies included

Arrange a beautiful mixed bowl of drought-tolerant succulents to take home. We'll cover soil, spacing, drainage, and summer care. Great for beginners and kids 10+.

Reserve Your Spot
Jul 26

Repotting Clinic

Saturday · 10am–12pm · $35 per person · Bring your own plant or use ours

Bring a rootbound plant from home, or work with one of ours. Learn how to choose the right pot, the right soil, and the right time to repot — plus hands-on practice.

Reserve Your Spot
Sep 7

Early Fall Wreaths

Sunday · 12pm–3pm · $65 per person · Includes all fresh greenery & wire frame

Welcome the season with a lush mixed-greenery wreath. We'll work with eucalyptus, cedar, dried seedheads, and seasonal foliage. Your wreath leaves with you same day.

Our Favorites Right Now

Staff picks

Golden Pothos

Genuinely hard to kill. Low light, irregular watering, small apartment — it doesn't care. New growth all summer long.

Staff Pick
Calathea Orbifolia

Stunning striped leaves and 100% pet-safe. A little dramatic about humidity — a pebble tray helps — but worth every drop.

Pet Safe
Stoneware Planters

Made by a ceramicist in Kalamazoo. Matte toffee glaze, drainage hole, and a weight that makes plants feel settled. They sell out fast.

Locally Made
Cedar Candles

Poured in small batches in South Haven. Clean-burning soy wax, cedar and white tea scent. The whole shop smells like this and people always ask.

Michigan Made
